card.name: Linking words before renal terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, the, to, or cause, right before a kidney-related term like renal secretion, elimination or prostaglandin synthesis, in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Of/the before renal
modes.description: A short linking word such as of or via directly precedes the word renal or a kidney transport term.
modes.example: Probenecid is a blocker<< of>> renal tubular secretion.

modes.label: Verb before elimination
modes.description: A verb or linking word precedes elimination or secretion in a drug interaction statement.
modes.example: lithium concomitantly with drugs which<< cause>> elimination of sodium
